start: Member of a gym with its own colour, Wear OS watch with the MettleUp watch app

steps.action: Start a workout on the phone
user_sees: The watch app opens drawn in the gym's colour (lightened if too dark for the black screen)
must_not: MettleUp orange for a gym with a colour
A colour too dark to read on the watch

start: Gym with only a background tone and no colour of its own

must_not: The background tone used as the watch colour
A blank or broken colour on the watch
An earlier gym's colour

start: Member leaves the gym between two workouts

user_sees: The watch back in MettleUp orange
must_not: The old gym's colour kept on the watch
The colour changing in the middle of a workout

start: Member of a gym with its own colour, Wear OS watch with the MettleUp watch app; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With saved data saved by the old version, update the app, then do "Gym's colour on the watch app".
user_sees: The old saved data shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Do step 1 of "Gym's colour on the watch app" on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.

must_not: Two different values on phone and watch, a double Gym made by both, or the watch stuck on the old state
